# Test Report

## Finding One

Formative assessment is among the most strongly supported classroom practices in education research [1]. Its international reach is documented from the United States to Pakistan to Ethiopia [2]. Guided play outperforms direct instruction on selected outcomes [3].

## Bibliography
[1] Author. (2024). Formative assessment effects. Journal One.
[2] Author. (2023). International reach of assessment reforms. Journal Two.
[3] Author. (2022). Guided play outcomes. Journal Three.

## Methodology Appendix

The run executed the full eight-phase pipeline in deep mode: scope, plan, retrieve, triangulate, and so on. Retrieval registered sources with stable cryptographic identities. Quotes were persisted to an append-only evidence store as evidence rows before synthesis began, and the route is recorded in the run manifest. The search CLI was unavailable on this harness, so the documented fallback chain was used. Source evaluation scored all domains before registration.
